description.en:
Shows letters over any farmed ground that currently has an open job (ready to harvest, needs weeding/plowing/seeding/rolling/fertilizer/lime), right on the minimap/map. Finds farmed ground directly, not just the map's pre-defined fields, so tillage-expanded and player-merged areas are covered too -- including rice paddies spanning multiple underlying fields as one label. Purely additive -- doesn't touch or replace any existing map overlay, so it plays fine alongside other minimap mods. Requires FS25_whatAmILookingAt (WAILA) -- it owns the actual field scan/tracking now, this mod just draws from it.
Formerly SmartMinimapAuto -- renamed for searchability, no functional change from the rename itself.
